verdict.rationale: Requesty offers EU-specific routing (Frankfurt, AWS eu-central-1) where all processing/storage stays in the EU, giving users a concrete regional data residency option, but there's no evidence of broader multi-region choice (e.g., US, APAC) or self-service region selection beyond the single EU option. Missing for 10: documented list of multiple selectable regions, self-serve UI/API control over region choice, and independent confirmation of data residency guarantees.
